title: Website Accessibility Features
description: Features designed to help people with hearing impairment and other accessibility needs

features.name: Font Size Adjustment
features.description: Users can increase or decrease text size from 75% to 150% of normal size
features.how_to_use: Click the accessibility button (♿) in the bottom-right corner and use the A+ and A- buttons
features.benefit: Makes text easier to read for people with visual impairments

features.name: Visual Indicators
features.description: Shows visual cues for all audio and video content
features.how_to_use: Enabled by default, can be toggled in accessibility settings
features.benefit: Alerts users to multimedia content that may have audio

features.name: High Contrast Mode
features.description: Increases contrast between text and background for better readability
features.benefit: Helps people with visual impairments distinguish content

features.name: Video Captions
features.description: All ministry videos include captions and text descriptions
features.how_to_use: Captions are automatically available on YouTube videos
features.benefit: Makes video content accessible to people with hearing impairment

features.name: Persistent Settings
features.description: Accessibility preferences are saved and applied across all pages
features.how_to_use: Settings are automatically remembered using browser localStorage
features.benefit: Users don't need to reconfigure settings on each page visit

technical_details.implementation: Vanilla JavaScript with CSS custom properties
technical_details.responsive: Accessibility panel adapts to mobile screens

contact.purpose: Committed to making digital content accessible to everyone
